1: SELECT category_id, SUM(stock) FROM products GROUP BY category_id;
2: SELECT u.name FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.id = 5;
3: SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id JOIN users u ON o.customer_id = u.id WHERE u.name = 'John Doe';
4: SELECT AVG(r.rating) FROM reviews r WHERE r.product_id = (     SELECT p.id     FROM products p     WHERE p.name = 'Laptop' );
5: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_login_attempts WHERE success_status = 1 AND attempt_time >= datetime('now', '-30 days');
6: SELECT st.subject FROM support_tickets st JOIN users u ON st.user_id = u.id JOIN user_profiles up ON u.id = up.id WHERE up.theme = 'dark';
7: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN devices d ON o.customer_id = d.user_id WHERE d.platform = 'Android';
8: SELECT SUM(cart_items.quantity) FROM cart_items JOIN cart ON cart_items.cart_id = cart.id JOIN users ON cart.user_id = users.id WHERE users.name = 'Jane Smith';
9: SELECT * FROM coupons WHERE discount_percent > 20 AND active = 1;
10: SELECT tracking_number FROM shipments WHERE order_id = 3;
12: SELECT u.email FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.customer_id IS NULL;
13: SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM reviews GROUP BY product_id;
15: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > 100;
16: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS device_count FROM devices GROUP BY user_id;
17: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;
19: SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payments p WHERE p.payment_status = 'completed';
